target: Transfer the historical graph-tautology Formula-Caching lower bound to JANUS-FC_local with Policy-0A's deterministic one-pass local Resolution rule.

residual_raw_order_witness.failure_mode: A local pass can falsify every critical total order compatible only with the reconstructed entry assignment at internal states.

historical_target_frontier.measure: Novel branches joining different connected components of the current partial-order Hasse diagram.

component_merge_provenance.source_verification: Every acyclic unit merge has a replayed source clause; every post-local merge is sourced by an explicit resolvent in the current one-pass trace.
component_merge_provenance.timing: Every verified unit merge occurs exactly at novelty level n-2 and closes the final 2-to-1 component gap.

resource_decomposition.branch_merge: Component reduction caused by an explicit novel branch comparison.
resource_decomposition.pre_unit_merge: Component reduction caused by unit propagation in the child residual before cache lookup.
resource_decomposition.post_local_unit_merge: Component reduction caused by a unit derived after the registered local Resolution pass.
resource_decomposition.cache_reuse: Reuse of a completed exact residual judgement without replaying descendants.

missing_lemmas: Prove early-unit-merge exclusion for every n: before n-2 novel joins, neither residual units nor one-pass local Resolution can join different current components.
Prove asymptotic separation of the first 2^(n-2) historical restrictions under Policy-0A exact residual normalization.
Charge any local Resolution contradiction before the target so that polynomial local work cannot eliminate the complete historical frontier.
Normalize the final lower bound to the actual graph-tautology CNF encoding length.
falsification_conditions: Construct an infinite family with a unit-induced component merge before novelty level n-2.
Construct exponentially many historical target restrictions mapping to polynomially many exact residual keys.
Construct a polynomial JANUS-FC_local execution family for graph tautologies.
Show that the historical novelty count depends on a property not preserved by Policy-0A residual normalization and without a polynomial repair.
claim_boundary: C024 verifies finite preservation of the historical target frontier for 4<=n<=8. It has not proved the preservation lemmas for all n, has not transferred the asymptotic graph-tautology lower bound to Policy-0A, and does not resolve P versus NP.
